name: Napa County Housing Authority
description: Section 8 housing vouchers for Napa County residents
fullDescription: The Housing Authority of the City of Napa (HACN), staffed by the City of Napa Housing Division, provides Section 8 rental assistance countywide for low-income seniors, families, and people with disabilities.
whatTheyOffer:
- Section 8 Housing Choice Vouchers
- Project-based vouchers at select properties
- Family Unification Program and Mainstream vouchers
- Shelter Plus Care program
- Family Self-Sufficiency program (for current participants)
howToGetIt:
1. Check the HACN Waiting List page for openings
2. Apply online when a waitlist opens (applicants are chosen by lottery)
3. Must meet income limits
4. Check your status at waitlistcheck.com
5. Questions or reasonable accommodation requests: call 707-257-9543
keywords: Napa Housing Authority, Section 8, housing voucher, Napa, wine country, low-income, waitlist
